title: selaginella tetragonostachya
intro: Selaginella tetragonostachya, commonly known as the Spikemoss or Tiger's Tail, is a species of spikemoss in the family Selaginellaceae, a type of non-vascular plant that belongs to the ancient group of vascular-free plants known as bryophytes. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of fever, pain, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and modulating the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Selaginella tetragonostachya include its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
